completed_platform_fixes_this_loop: Bench LLM route audit is now stage-aware for --start-from director and no longer falsely requires PM/Chief Engineer calls in Director-only resume.
Factory bench chain records factory_bench_start_from so terminal audit can distinguish full-chain partial runs from Director-only resume runs.
Materialization quality repair now pins delivery_mode=materialize_changes in both repair context metadata and the repair message SESSION_PATCH.
Regression tests cover Director-only required-role audit and repair delivery-mode pinning.

Director materialization quality repair now parses npm package script missing local entrypoint errors, maps test globs to concrete source test targets, filters generated outputs such as dist/build/out, and merges those missing entrypoints into the forced write_file repair batch.
Director semantic quality repair now treats unresolved import symbol errors as first-class semantic repair triggers and preserves cross-file symbol repair batches after the first attempt.

Director semantic quality repair now extracts TypeScript diagnostic file paths such as src/index.ts(32,14): error TS2304 and filters tsc command config arguments such as tsconfig.json from repair targets when diagnostics are present.
Deterministic npm script repair now handles missing verify local entrypoints by rewriting verify to npm run build and test to npm run verify when it referenced the missing verify file.
Director semantic quality repair now treats unresolved TypeScript import/export symbol failures as coupled importer+exporter repair batches, including imports with explicit .ts suffixes.
Director semantic quality repair now targets TS18046 unknown exported values at both declaration and usage files and preserves that batch across retry attempts.
Deterministic TypeScript repair now adds local import type bindings when a file uses a symbol in type position that it only re-exports from another module.
Director single-target quality repair and empty-write retry now set _transaction_kernel_force_exact_tools=True so provider tools cannot include read/list/repo companions during write-only repair.
Weak Director materialize slim schema now keeps mutation/diff/execute tools only; read/locate context must be prepared before write stage.

Roles Kernel now has an auditable Prompt Profile selector: built-in language/task/role-stage/artifact templates, .polaris/prompt_profiles user templates, red-line validation, selected_prompt_profile_ids, and quality-repair skip behavior.

Director-only resume now resets current runtime TaskBoard task rows and deletes task session files before rerunning Director, with director_resume_reset.json evidence in both bench and HTTP Factory paths.
Director dispatch now stops before a no-claim retry when a single-binding materialization quality failure already wrote workspace artifacts and qualifies for quality_gate handoff.

Deterministic TypeScript missing-export repair now parses export aliases correctly and avoids aliasing constructed class-like symbols to enums; it falls back to generated class stubs with used methods.

Deterministic TypeScript missing-export repair now ignores indented function-local declarations when selecting similar alias candidates, preventing invalid exports such as `export { flowers as Flower };`.
